invariant: worker slot ownership is bound to a unique session_id; a chat may act for a slot only when its locally retained session_id matches durable slot.session_id

protocols.session_id: each fresh chat generates a fresh opaque 32-hex session_id before registration; session_id has no authority until bound by successful registration CAS
protocols.registration: select lexicographically smallest FREE slot; bind slot.session_id to caller session_id; exact-head CAS with force=false
protocols.registration_conflict: reread state; preserve peer registrations; retry next FREE slot; never adopt an ACTIVE slot whose session_id differs
protocols.resume: chat may resume its registered slot only when locally retained session_id exactly matches durable slot.session_id; otherwise it is a distinct new session
protocols.action_claim: after registration, select lexicographically smallest PENDING action; record both owner_worker and owner_session_id; exact-head CAS
protocols.action_ownership: a chat may act on claimed action only when BOTH worker ID and session_id match durable action ownership
